falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 cash index closes at least 5.0% below its close on day 0 of this window on any session within 14 days, and that close is also below the August 5, 2024 intraday low analog (the reference trough in the bottom_2024_aug pattern).
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% bottom_2024_aug match is invalidated: price has broken the pattern's recovery structure rather than basing, so UNKNOWN/HOLD is wrong and the correct call is downside continuation, not a hold through a bottom.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 cash index closes at least 6.0% above its day-0 close within 14 days AND VIX closes below 14.0 on the same session or the session after.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The tape has resolved the unknown into a confirmed risk-on recovery, not a hold. Staying HOLD through a >6% rally with volatility crushed would mean the engine missed a completed bottom and a directional long signal.

falsification_conditions.condition: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by at least 75 basis points versus its day-0 level at any point in the next 14 days, or the 10-year US Treasury yield moves at least 40 basis points from its day-0 close in either direction with the S&P 500 down at least 3.0% over the same span.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Cross-asset stress or a rates shock has broken the low-blowoff (score 38), range-bound hold regime. A 75bp credit widening or a 40bp yield shock coincident with equity weakness falsifies both the bottom-repair analog and the HOLD signal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
